description: Browse your StorageWeb servers, open and save their files, and keep the folder you work on synchronized.
untrusted: Synchronizing sends and receives files: it needs a trusted workspace.
cmd.link: Synchronize a folder of this window…
cfg.server: Address of StorageWeb (`https://files.company.com`). Set by **StorageWeb: Link folder**.
cfg.username: User name in StorageWeb. The token is kept in the secret storage of VS Code, never in the settings.
cfg.remoteFolder: Folder of StorageWeb synchronized with this one: `home/…` (your personal folder) or the name of a shared folder.
cfg.autoSync: Upload the changes when saving, creating, renaming or deleting files. Disabled: only the periodic and manual synchronizations.
cfg.pollSeconds: Seconds between full synchronizations (to bring the changes made on the server).
cfg.exclude: More patterns that are not synchronized (besides `.git`, `node_modules`, `.venv`, `__pycache__` and temporary files), only on this computer. For example `dist/**` or `**/*.log`. To share them with the other computers, use the `.storagewebignore` file of the folder.
cfg.confirmDeletesOver: Ask before deleting more than this many files in one synchronization (in case a folder was emptied by mistake).
cmd.addToWorkspace: Add to the workspace (edit on the server)
welcome.servers:
No StorageWeb server yet.
[Add server](command:storageweb.addServer)
You can sign in with the browser (also with Microsoft) or use your user and an API token (StorageWeb → My profile → API tokens).
welcome.syncs:
No folder of this window is synchronized.
[Synchronize a folder](command:storageweb.link)
Or, in Servers, right-click a folder → Synchronize with a local folder.
cfg.useGitignore: Do not synchronize what the `.gitignore` at the root of the folder ignores (lines with `!` are not supported).
